raw_intervention.description: \[68Ga\]Ga-TTP is a TROP2-targeted PET radiotracer administered intravenously for PET imaging. In the diagnostic validation cohort, participants undergo one \[68Ga\]Ga-TTP PET examination within 1 week of the comparator \[18F\]FDG scan. In the ADC response assessment cohort, participants undergo \[68Ga\]Ga-TTP PET imaging before ADC therapy, after 2 cycles of treatment(each cycle is 21 days), and at disease progression. The planned administered activity is approximately 0.05-0.1 mCi/kg.
raw_intervention.name: [68Ga]Ga-TTP
